evidence.reason: The dependency regex at lines 99-102 enumerates [Unit] dependency directives but omits systemd's StopPropagatedFrom= and its inverse PropagatesStopTo=. Those directives create a real stop-propagation path: a co-installed unit declaring StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service can be stopped when the fence stops crq-tick.service, and discovery will not see or reject that dependency. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency-scan protection, not a request for new policy scope.
